title: Senior Threat Hunting (Lead)
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a Senior Threat Hunter to lead hypothesis-driven, intelligence-led hunts across enterprise, cloud, and OT/IoT environments. This role proactively identifies adversary tradecraft that evades existing detections, operationalizes findings into durable detection logic, and partners with Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, IR, Exposure Management, and REM to reduce dwell time and shrink the enterprise exposure plane. The hunter will leverage MITRE ATT&CK, the Pyramid of Pain, and the Diamond Model to drive measurable risk reduction.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead hypothesis-driven, intelligence-led hunt campaigns from formulation through reporting, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK
* Design and execute custom analytics against large-scale security telemetry (SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, cloud, network) to uncover adversary tradecraft that evades existing detections
* Perform identity-centric hunting across Entra ID, Active Directory, and SaaS platforms - token theft, session hijacking, MFA bypass, OAuth abuse, and conditional access circumvention.
* Conduct cloud-native hunting across AWS, Azure, M365, and SaaS control planes, including audit logs, identity events, and workload telemetry.
* Convert hunt findings into durable detections, signatures, and SOAR playbooks in partnership with Detection Engineering, closing the hunt-to-detect loop
* Perform Deception Operations by defining adversary-aligned use cases, authoring detection requirements for deception-generated activity, and tuning signal vs. noise thresholds
* Leverage AI and LLM-assisted tooling to accelerate hunting - including query generation, log summarization, entity pivoting, anomaly clustering, and large-scale pattern discovery across disparate telemetry sources
* Hunt within AI and LLM environments - including enterprise copilots, internal/external LLM deployments, AI agents, RAG pipelines, model endpoints, and AI/ML infrastructure - for threats such as prompt injection, model abuse, data exfiltration via AI channels, agent hijacking, supply-chain compromise of models, and unauthorized model access
* Produce post-hunt reports with explicit evidence and measurable outcomes tied to exposure reduction
* Partner with Threat Intelligence to operationalize finished intel into targeted hunt missions and feed collection requirements upstream
* Support purple-team exercises and validate detection efficacy against adversary emulation campaigns (Atomic Red Team, CALDERA, Stratus Red Team)
* Develop and maintain custom tooling and automation to support hunting, investigation, and analyst efficiency
* Mentor junior hunters; contribute to internal knowledge bases, hunt libraries, and team training
* Support Incident Response, Forensics, and Insider Threat / Fraud investigations as a senior technical resource when adversary expertise is needed
* Serve as a liaison for Threat Services across Cyber Operations, communicating findings clearly to technical peers and executive leadership
* Identify needs, drive solutions, and operate autonomously within strategic priorities

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in security operations, with 4+ of those dedicated to threat hunting
* Deep experience hunting in large, complex enterprise environments
* Demonstrable experience executing MITRE ATT&CK-aligned hunts with documented outcomes and detection handoffs

**Job Title – Staff Cloud Service Engineer III (Microsoft 365 Email Security & SMTP)** **Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Email Security & Microsoft 365 Messaging Engineer to own engineering, operation and continuous improvement of enterprise email platform, mail flow and email security services across a global estate. This is a hands-on technical role for a professional who can take ownership of complex incidents and engineering work, not an entry-level or developmental position.

The successful candidate will manage, evolve, support Exchange Online, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Purview, Cisco secure email gateways, SMTP relay services Public DNS configuration and hygiene adhering to industry standards. They will work with security, identity, network and application teams, and with suppliers, to keep email secure, deliverable, compliant and reliable.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the configuration of Cisco secure email gateways, including inbound and outbound routing, policies, quarantine and encryption.
* Design, manage and troubleshoot Exchange Online services, including transport rules, connectors, accepted and remote domains, mailbox and distribution group settings, and migrations.
* Design, configure and optimize Microsoft Defender for Office 365 policies, including anti-spam, anti-phishing with impersonation protection, anti-malware, Safe Links, Safe Attachments and pre-set security policies.
* Own email authentication for all company domains: SPF, DKIM, DMARC
* Design and support SMTP relay and application email services
* Onboard and govern applications, devices (such as multifunction printers and scanners) and SaaS platforms that send email on behalf of company domains, making sure they are authenticated, approved and documented.
* Investigate and remediate phishing, business email compromise, spoofing and malware campaigns with the Security Operations team, using Threat Explorer, message trace, Advanced Hunting and automated investigation and response.
* Monitor mail flow health, deliverability, queue and reputation issues, using Exchange Admin Centre, Defender portal, message trace, Microsoft 365 Service Health and gateway reporting.
* Support Microsoft Purview controls that apply to email: data loss prevention, sensitivity labels, message encryption, retention, eDiscovery and journaling.
* Use ServiceNow and Jira to manage incidents, requests, problems, changes and project activities in line with operational processes.
* Create and maintain designs, runbooks, mail flow diagrams, standards, domain and sender inventories, and knowledge articles.
* Provide clear technical guidance and knowledge transfer to service desk teams, application owners and other engineers.

**Role Scope & Technical Ownership**

This is an experienced engineering role responsible for independently handling complex work, making sound operational decisions and contributing to the technical direction of messaging and email security. It includes broad technical ownership across:

* SMTP relay services for applications, devices and third-party platforms.
* Exchange Online, and mail flow architecture, including routing through secure email gateways.
* Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and the wider email threat protection stack.
* Domain and sender governance: SPF, DKIM, DMARC enforcement and the inventory of approved senders.
* Email-related identity and access controls, including Conditional Access, modern authentication and the removal of legacy protocols.
* Email data protection and compliance with Microsoft Purview.
* Technical leadership during email incidents, including deciding when to block, quarantine, reroute, roll back a change, escalate or engage a specialist.
* Global service delivery, Incident, Change and Problem Management, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
* Automation with PowerShell (Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph), Power Automate and Logic Apps to improve operations and reporting.
* Mentoring less-experienced engineers and service desk teams.

**Skills & Experience** **Exchange Online & Messaging**

* Hands-on professional experience engineering and supporting Exchange Online in a large enterprise.
* Strong knowledge of mail flow: connectors, transport rules, accepted domains, centralized mail transport, and routing through third-party gateways.
* Experience with mailbox types, shared and resource mailboxes, distribution and Microsoft 365 groups, permissions and migrations.
* Confident use of message trace, Exchange Admin Centre, Microsoft 365 Service Health and Microsoft support escalation.

**Email Security**

* Practical experience configuring and tuning Microsoft Defender for Office 365
* Experience administering secure email gateway
* Detailed understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, ARC, MTA-STS and TLS, and experience moving domains to DMARC enforcement.
* Experience investigating phishing, spoofing and business email compromise with Security Operations teams.
* Working knowledge of email encryption, data loss prevention and sensitivity labels in Microsoft Purview.

**SMTP & Application Email**

* Deep understanding of SMTP: the protocol, headers, response codes, TLS negotiation, MX and DNS records, and bounce (NDR) analysis.
* Experience designing and supporting SMTP relay for applications and devices, including authenticated submission, connector-based relay and third-party relay services.
* Experience planning and delivering the retirement of Basic Authentication and legacy SMTP AUTH.
* Ability to diagnose deliverability problems blocklists, IP and domain reputation, throttling, and recipient-side rejections.

**Identity, Automation & Operations**

* Working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, modern authentication and licensing as they apply to messaging.
* Strong PowerShell skills (Exchange Online module, Microsoft Graph); experience with Power Automate or Logic Apps is desirable.
* Working understanding of DNS, firewalls, proxies and TLS certificates.
* Strong systematic troubleshooting: restore service first, then complete root-cause analysis.
* Experience managing incidents and changes through ServiceNow or a comparable IT service management platform.

**Communication & Customer Support**

* Ability to explain technical issues clearly to the audience and give concise, actionable updates.
* Comfortable working under time pressure, for example during an active phishing campaign, while keeping sound judgement.
* Professional written and spoken English suitable for global engineering, security and business teams.

**Personal Attributes**

* Accountable: owns technical issues from first diagnosis through restoration, escalation and closure.
* Security-minded: balances protection against deliverability and user experience, and document why each decision was made.
* Calm, methodical and decisive during live incidents such as phishing campaigns or mail flow outages.
* Curious and committed to keeping up with changes in Microsoft 365, email standards and the threat landscape.
* Confident making recommendations, and comfortable admitting knowledge gaps and bringing in specialists.
* Collaborative and non-territorial, working well with security, identity, network and application teams.
* Organized and detail-oriented, with a commitment to documentation, standards, change control and knowledge transfer.
* Respectful and constructively challenging, able to push back on risky sender or relay requests without undermining colleagues.
* Comfortable working independently while staying connected to a globally distributed team.

**Desired Overall Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a strong messaging engineer who understands email end to end from SMTP and DNS on the wire, through Exchange Online and the security stack, to the people and applications that depend on it. They are neither only an Exchange administrator nor only a security analyst.

They do not need expert knowledge of every product. More important is the breadth to understand how mail flow, security controls, identity and DNS interact, to isolate the likely fault quickly, and to engage the right specialists when needed.

Hands-on Exchange Online and email security experience, strong SMTP troubleshooting, calm decision-making, clear communication and the ability to work at an experienced engineering level within a collaborative global team are essential.

**Company Description**

**Eurofins Scientific** is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

 **Job Description**

**Job Title:** Solution Database Engineer

**Work Location:** Bangalore

**Shift timings:** 8.00am to 5.00pm OR 12.00pm to 9.00pm IST

**Work mode:** Hybrid - 3 Days office

**Role Summary:**  
We are seeking an experienced Data Warehouse Developer to design, develop, and maintain enterprise data integration solutions that support business intelligence, analytics, operational reporting, and data-driven decision-making. The successful candidate will be responsible for building and optimizing ETL processes, developing SSIS packages, designing data warehouse solutions, and creating efficient SQL queries and stored procedures to extract, transform, merge, and deliver data from multiple systems.

This role requires strong expertise in Microsoft SQL Server technologies, data modeling, data governance, performance tuning, and large-scale data integration.

**Key Responsibilities**

Data Integration & ETL Development

Design, develop, test, and maintain SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) packages for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL).

Integrate data from multiple internal and external sources, including SQL Server databases, flat files, APIs, cloud platforms, and third-party applications.

Develop robust error handling, logging, and monitoring mechanisms within ETL processes.

Troubleshoot and resolve ETL failures, performance bottlenecks, and data quality issues.

Data Warehouse Development

Design and maintain enterprise data warehouses, data marts, and staging environments.

Develop dimensional models including star and snowflake schemas.

Implement data cleansing, transformation, and standardization processes.

Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate reporting and analytics requirements into scalable warehouse solutions.

SQL Development & Performance Optimization

Write complex, highly optimized T-SQL queries, views, functions, and stored procedures.

Develop efficient data retrieval and transformation logic across large datasets.

Analyze execution plans and optimize database performance through indexing, partitioning, and query tuning.

Ensure scalable and maintainable database solutions that support growing business needs.

Data Quality & Governance

Implement data validation processes to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

Identify and resolve data discrepancies across systems.

Support data governance initiatives and maintain metadata documentation.

Ensure compliance with organizational security and data management standards.

Reporting & Analytics Support

Support reporting teams by developing data structures optimized for BI tools such as Power BI, SSRS, or Tableau.

Create and maintain reusable datasets and reporting views.

Assist analysts and business users with complex data requests and ad-hoc analyses.

Documentation & Collaboration

Create and maintain technical documentation for ETL processes, data mappings, warehouse structures, and database objects.

Participate in architecture and design reviews.

Collaborate with developers, DBAs, business analysts, and project managers throughout the SDLC.

Support production deployments and post-implementation troubleshooting.

Experience

5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Warehouse Development.

5+ years of SQL Server development experience.

3+ years of experience developing and supporting SSIS packages and ETL solutions.

Experience working with large enterprise databases and high-volume transactional systems.

Microsoft SQL Server 2016/2019/2022

SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)

SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)

SQL Server Agent

SQL Development

Advanced T-SQL programming
